name: GPU Specification Verification
summary: Verify that the GPU hardware and driver configuration matches the declared specification including model, VRAM, driver version, and CUDA version
purpose: Verify that the GPU hardware and driver configuration matches the declared specification including model, VRAM, driver version, and CUDA version.
assignment_instructions: You are verifying GPU specifications against declared requirements. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "compute_gpu_spec_verification_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - gpu_model_detected (string): GPU model name from system - gpu_model_declared (string or null): expected GPU model - gpu_model_match (boolean): exact string match of model names - vram_detected_gb (number): detected VRAM in gigabytes - vram_required_gb (number or null): minimum required VRAM - vram_sufficient (boolean): vram_detected_gb >= vram_required_gb (or true if no requirement) - driver_version_detected (string): detected driver version - driver_version_required (string or null): required driver version - driver_version_match (boolean): exact match or meeting minimum - cuda_version_detected (string): detected CUDA version - cuda_version_required (string or null): required CUDA version - cuda_version_match (boolean): exact match or meeting minimum - all_specs_match (boolean): true only if gpu_model_match and vram_sufficient and driver_version_match and cuda_version_match are all true Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. State exact versions as strings. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

deterministic_checks.description: vram_sufficient must be true when vram >= required
deterministic_checks.assertion: result.vram_sufficient == (result.vram_detected_gb >= result.vram_required_gb if result.vram_required_gb else True)

deterministic_checks.description: all_specs_match must be true only when all individual checks pass
deterministic_checks.assertion: result.all_specs_match == (result.gpu_model_match and result.vram_sufficient and result.driver_version_match and result.cuda_version_match)

deterministic_checks.description: driver and CUDA versions must be non-empty strings
deterministic_checks.assertion: isinstance(result.driver_version_detected, str) and len(result.driver_version_detected) > 0 and isinstance(result.cuda_version_detected, str) and len(result.cuda_version_detected) > 0

evidence_checks.description: Must quote exact GPU model string from system output
Must report exact VRAM value from system output
Must quote exact driver version from system output

flag_rules.description: Detected GPU model does not match declared specification
Detected VRAM is below required minimum
Driver version does not meet requirement
CUDA version does not meet requirement
